title: Mission Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0 — Scheme Guidelines
titleHi: मिशन सक्षम आंगनवाड़ी एवं पोषण 2.0 — योजना दिशानिर्देश
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
edition: Mission Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0 Scheme Guidelines
sourceNote: Official (Ministry of Women and Child Development). The official document repository lists the Mission Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0 Scheme Guidelines.
